body.statement: If one strategy set is compact and convex, the other is convex, and the payoff is upper semicontinuous and concave in the compact-side variable and lower semicontinuous and convex in the other variable, then the maximum of the infima equals the infimum of the maxima.

source.verbatim_statement: Let M and N be convex spaces one of which is compact, and f a function on M×N, quasi-concave-convex and u.s.c.-l.s.c. Then sup inf f = inf sup f.

attestation.note: Transcribed from the official MSP PDF of Sion (1958), Corollary 3.5 immediately after Theorem 3.4: https://msp.org/pjm/1958/8-1/pjm-v8-n1-p14-p.pdf.
